observations: Relative to inputs/original.png, all four views now have visibly softer rounded lid-board, rim and brace transitions. Golden edge catches and broad smooth bevel shading convey the requested cartoon volume while retaining the compact crate construction.
The lower inset has moved from the source dense dark brown to readable warm brown. The N/S diagonal braces remain distinct against it, and the lower frame does not collapse into a black band.

Honey-yellow lid boards, orange-brown side sections and amber frame/brace preserve the original wood palette family while moving materially toward the warm fixed target. Highlights remain warm rather than white.

N/S show the corresponding native diagonal braces; E/W show their end-on construction and rotated horizontal lid boards. Finish and face shading remain coherent across orientations. These side projections are attached geometry rather than detached or broken corners.
At logical 192x352 frame size, the individual boards, panel and braces remain clear. The repeated preview reads as consistent wood crates without noisy grain or busy highlight outlines.

All four direct native frames and the packet previews were inspected. Additional logical composites on light, middle gray and dark backgrounds show clean silhouettes without target-like colored fringe, black dead spots, clipping, floating shadow residue or material overlap seams.
remainingDifferences: The fixed target has somewhat stronger orange contrast and shinier narrow edge catches; this candidate uses gentler low-gloss golden light, consistent with the agreed warm soft cartoon interpretation.
Large wood faces remain simplified and grain-free. This is acceptable under the frozen material criterion and improves runtime readability.
The target apparent silhouette expansion and noisy colored fringe were correctly not reproduced.
